responsibility: Declares the public middle-end interface for GCC’s Pointer Bounds Checker support shared by instrumentation, optimization, IPA, and expansion code. It exposes macros for attaching bounds metadata to decls, APIs for registering static initializers and finishing file-level CHKP setup, querying pointer-containing types and bound-slot layouts, creating and retrieving canonical zero/none bounds values, building and inserting CHKP builtin calls for check/load/store/return-bounds operations, fixing CFG after transformations, tracking whether functions are already instrumented, redirecting clone/inlining edges, and target-facing expansion helpers for bounds values and memory resets.
same_name_distinction: Provides the shared declaration surface for CHKP support—macros and extern APIs used across instrumentation, IPA, and expansion code—without implementing the pass itself; unlike tree-chkp.c, it is the header that exposes reusable interfaces and metadata accessors for the tree-chkp functionality.
